notes.title: Movement updated!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for May 22nd - Movement updated!
[/h1]

[h2]Fixes and new features
[/h2]

► We’ve upgraded the jump mechanics. Jump and avoid obstacles with more precision, setting new records in the game faster than ever!

► Less momentum. It will now be easier not to overshoot the platforms and fall on the spikes, thanks to our improvements in overall momentum.

Once again, we express our gratitude for your engagement with Ingression: The Portal Trial. Your opinions matter, and we genuinely welcome your feedback! Whether shared in reviews, discussions, or on our social media platforms, we attentively read every comment.

notes.title: Ingression | OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Creating Ingression has been the most thrilling and demanding adventure of my life. For over a year, I've poured my heart and soul into shaping this challenging and mind-bending precision platformer, where each jump is a calculated risk and every portal leads to new trials.

[previewyoutube=_WrC7sOdn4A;full][/previewyoutube]

I spent countless late nights coding, refining, and testing every element of the game. There were moments of frustration when bugs seemed bad and doubts crept in about my ability to see it through alone.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966970/Ingression

For me, Ingression isn't just a game; it's a milestone, a defining moment in my journey as a developer. No matter where life takes me next, I'll always cherish this project, knowing that I created something truly exceptional.

Thank you for purchasing this and sharing your thoughts about it in the reviews!

[h2][b]Oh, and don't forget about our socials![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Custom Controls Unleashed!
notes.content:

notes.title: Play Ingression: The Portal Trial for free!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey-hey, runners![/b][/h1]

We have great news for you all, and it is regarding you being able to play [b]Ingression[/b]! 

[h3]We are launching a completely free prologue![/h3]
You will be able to complete the first chapter of the game and participate in a special [b]Trial level[/b].

[previewyoutube=xL5ZFyxfM-8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Wishlist the game![/b][/h2]

If you like the game - wishlist the main steam page of Ingression. This will greatly help us get attention from the almighty Steam algorythms and get new audience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966970/Ingression/

[h3]Here's the link if you want to install the prologue right now, and while you are downloading it and wishlisting the main game - let's dive into the ✨[i][b]details[/b][/i]✨[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761970/Ingression_The_Portal_Trial/

[h2][b]Jump through seamless portals[/b][/h2]

One of the [b]most [/b]fun things in the whole game for sure are [u][b]seamless portals[/b][/u]. And when you combine them with a dynamic precision platformer - it creates an absolutely wild gameplay that will put your reflexes to a test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/29c782de9b04cb4b4aced72a2e2ec1565ea2bad3.gif[/img]

We had [b][u]tons [/u][/b]of fun creating these levels, and we hope that you'll have even more fun playing them! I don't want to spoil the fun for you, but in the future, we'll have a [b]LOT[/b] more to show to you!

[h2][b]Dynamic gameplay[/b][/h2]

If you watched the trailer - I think you get what I mean, and if not - [spoiler]please watch it, we worked really hard to put it together 🙏[/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/13033af74e4dcba8cff64d462a2b6ffa97513663.gif[/img]

In any case, the levels are designed to be challenging enough for you to struggle your way through them, but not to an "almost impossible" level of struggle. If you are afraid that it will be too hard for you - then hey, give it a shot! The prologue is free and it will be here for a while.

[b]And if you find that the game's levels are too easy...[/b]

[h2][b]Challenge yourself with a Trial level![/b][/h2]

Oh boy, I've spent[b] countless [/b]hours on this one already...

A true testament to your skills and your will to be the best of the best. Sure, just going through it at your own pace is probably not that hard, but try to do it in under 20 seconds and you'll get what I mean. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/55933662edbf8621b6d7c9aba259b62e815afd58.gif[/img]

Compete with players [b]worldwide [/b]on the leaderboard, or get your friends and decide who's the best [u][b]once and for all![/b][/u]

And if you'll manage to do it in under 19 seconds... Well, I don't really have a reward for that, but chances are that your name will be on the top of the leadearboard!

[h2][b]Share your experience![/b][/h2]

Hop on in our [b]Community Hub[/b] to discuss the game, ask questions, and get a response from us! We would LOVE to hear what you think about our game, as we poured our hearts and souls into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/f9bea3806b9bf2686f307ab5be8579df12d95eb5.gif[/img]
